subject: We can’t predict the future Zain…
snippet:
…but maybe you can? 
 
 What could Wikipedia look like in your future?
 
 Hello!
 
 First, we want to say thank you again from all of us at the Wikimedia Foundation. Donors like you have helped keep Wikipedia free and independent for the last 25 years, and for this, you have our heartfelt gratitude.
